A.falsification: any 7-note mask or census mask deviating from 462
A.name: Phase-Sum Identity
A.statement: sum over p in 0..11 of pcSum(T_p(M)) = 7 * 66 = 462 for every 7-note mask M
A.trivialityTest: holds for arbitrary 7-subsets of Z_12 independent of census membership or orbit partition; checksum utility only

B.falsification: any orbit/phase pair violating 77*|O|, any violation of pcSum(T_p(M)) + pcSum(T_(11-p)(I0(M))) = 77, or I0 escaping an orbit
B.name: Reflection Pairing Involution
B.statement: mean_p(O) + mean_(11-p)(O) = 77 within every governed orbit, while pcSum(T_p(M)) + pcSum(T_(11-p)(M)) != 77 in general on chiral masks
B.trivialityTest: per-mask reflection fails on individual chiral masks (I0(M) != M); the orbit-level law is carried by the explicit involution I0: x -> (-x) mod 12

C.falsification: any non-integer w_p, any histogram mismatch, any duplicate orbit spectrum, or failure to separate D2 from D5
C.name: Orbit Phase Curves as Pitch-Class Tomography
C.statement: the cyclic step delta total_(p+1)-total_p = 7n - 12*w_p recovers the orbit pitch-class multiplicity histogram w_p = h_O((11-p) mod 12)
C.trivialityTest: the wrap ladder is orbit-specific; it must separate ORBIT-D2 from ORBIT-D5 despite their equal spread 213/35, and all 10 phase curves must be distinct

D.falsification: any additional or missing zero phase, asymmetry under p -> 11-p, or mismatch of the declared extrema
D.name: Achromatic Coincidence Set and Cross-Orbit Spread Profile
D.statement: cross-orbit spread is exactly zero only at p in {0, 11}; interior minimum 96/35 at p in {5, 6}; global maximum 60/7 at p in {3, 8}
D.trivialityTest: the zero set must be exactly {0, 11}, not a vacuous all-zero or all-nonzero profile

B1.falsification: BOUNDARY_CONFIRMED if any phase shows cross-orbit spread below the predeclared tolerance; BOUNDARY_REFUTED otherwise
B1.formulation: S_f(M,p) = sum over pc in T_p(M) of 440*2^((60+pc-69)/12) Hz; test whether cross-orbit spread of the orbit mean falls below 1e-9 Hz at any phase
B1.name: Container Frequency Sum Convergence
B1.rationale: 2^(x/12) is strictly convex, so orbit means at p in {0,11} split in proportion to differing second and higher pitch-class moments

B2.falsification: any step-law residual above tolerance, or log-dual deviation from pcSum
B2.formulation: S_f(M,(p+1) mod 12) = 2^(1/12)*S_f(M,p) - f_C4*1_(11 in T_p(M)), with f_C4 = 440*2^(-9/12); log dual (12/ln2)*sum ln(f(pc)/f_C4) = pcSum
B2.name: Multiplicative Frequency-Transport Step Law and Log Dual
B2.rationale: each wrapped pitch class loses exactly one octave; the logarithmic coordinate is linear in pitch class

C1.falsification: systematic mismatch beyond the predeclared relative tolerance of 1e-2 between measured and modelled centroids, or any non-finite centroid
C1.formulation: compare physical FFT spectral centroid C_FFT(b) against analytical overtone-weighted C_model(b) across all 86 voiced bars
C1.name: Renderer-to-Air FFT Fidelity

C2.falsification: office deconfounding failing to raise correlation on multi-office walks, or a non-finite correlation
C2.formulation: raw correlation r(C_FFT, pcSum) versus office-deconfounded correlation r(C_FFT - mean_office, pcSum) on single- and multi-office walks
C2.name: Symbolic pcSum and Fundamental Centroid Tracking

C3.falsification: any bar pair whose symbolic shift is not reproduced in sign or whose physical centroid is non-finite
C3.formulation: bar-by-bar physical centroid shift vs exact symbolic shift delta pcSum = 7*delta p - 12*delta w
C3.name: Equivariant Acoustic Shift track5 vs track6

discipline: Every candidate carries a triviality test and falsification criterion; classification is decided by generator case logic, never prose discretion.
